import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false

theorem complex_cubic_root_factor_classification (a b c d : ℂ) (h_ne : a ≠ d) :
  (a - d) * (a - c) * (a - b) = 0 ↔ a = b ∨ a = c := by
  have h₁ : ((a - d) * (a - c) * (a - b) = 0) ↔ a - d = 0 ∨ a - c = 0 ∨ a - b = 0 := by
    simp [sub_eq_zero]
    <;>
    (try ring_nf)
    <;>
    (try norm_num)
    <;>
    (try aesop)
    <;>
    (try
      {
        constructor <;> intro h <;>
        (try aesop) <;>
        (try simp_all [sub_eq_zero])
        <;>
        (try ring_nf at * <;> aesop)
      })
    <;>
    (try
      {
        aesop
      })
  have h₂ : (a - d = 0 ∨ a - c = 0 ∨ a - b = 0) ↔ a = b ∨ a = c := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₃ : a - d = 0 ∨ a - c = 0 ∨ a - b = 0 := h
      cases h₃ with
      | inl h₄ =>
        
        exfalso
        apply h_ne
        simp_all [sub_eq_zero]
        <;>
        (try ring_nf at * <;> aesop)
      | inr h₄ =>
        cases h₄ with
        | inl h₅ =>
          
          have h₆ : a - c = 0 := h₅
          have h₇ : a = c := by
            simp_all [sub_eq_zero]
          exact Or.inr h₇
        | inr h₅ =>
          
          have h₆ : a - b = 0 := h₅
          have h₇ : a = b := by
            simp_all [sub_eq_zero]
          exact Or.inl h₇
    · 
      intro h
      cases h with
      | inl h₁ =>
        
        have h₂ : a - b = 0 := by
          simp_all [sub_eq_zero]
          <;>
          (try ring_nf at * <;> aesop)
        exact Or.inr (Or.inr h₂)
      | inr h₁ =>
        
        have h₂ : a - c = 0 := by
          simp_all [sub_eq_zero]
          <;>
          (try ring_nf at * <;> aesop)
        exact Or.inr (Or.inl h₂)
  rw [h₁, h₂]
  <;>
  aesop

  have h₁ : (a - d) * (a - c) * (a - b) = 0 ↔ a - d = 0 ∨ a - c = 0 ∨ a - b = 0 := by
    
    apply Iff.intro
    · 
      intro h
      
      have h₂ : a - d = 0 ∨ a - c = 0 ∨ a - b = 0 := by
        
        simp [sub_eq_zero] at h ⊢
        
        aesop
      
      aesop
    · 
      intro h
      
      have h₂ : a - d = 0 ∨ a - c = 0 ∨ a - b = 0 := h
      
      cases h₂ with
      | inl h₂ =>
        
        simp [h₂, sub_eq_zero]
        <;> aesop
      | inr h₂ =>
        cases h₂ with
        | inl h₂ =>
          
          simp [h₂, sub_eq_zero]
          <;> aesop
        | inr h₂ =>
          
          simp [h₂, sub_eq_zero]
          <;> aesop
  
  have h₂ : a - d = 0 ∨ a - c = 0 ∨ a - b = 0 ↔ a = b ∨ a = c := by
    constructor
    · 
      intro h
      have h₃ : a - d = 0 ∨ a - c = 0 ∨ a - b = 0 := h
      have h₄ : a = b ∨ a = c := by
        
        cases h₃ with
        | inl h₃ =>
          
          have h₅ : a - d = 0 := h₃
          have h₆ : a = d := by
            
            have h₇ : a - d = 0 := h₅
            have h₈ : a = d := by
              
              apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
              simpa using h₇
            exact h₈
          exfalso
          
          apply h_ne
          simp [h₆]
        | inr h₃ =>
          cases h₃ with
          | inl h₃ =>
            
            have h₅ : a - c = 0 := h₃
            have h₆ : a = c := by
              
              have h₇ : a - c = 0 := h₅
              have h₈ : a = c := by
                
                apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
                simpa using h₇
              exact h₈
            exact Or.inr h₆
          | inr h₃ =>
            
            have h₅ : a - b = 0 := h₃
            have h₆ : a = b := by
              
              have h₇ : a - b = 0 := h₅
              have h₈ : a = b := by
                
                apply eq_of_sub_eq_zero
                simpa using h₇
              exact h₈
            exact Or.inl h₆
      exact h₄
    · 
      intro h
      have h₃ : a = b ∨ a = c := h
      have h₄ : a - d = 0 ∨ a - c = 0 ∨ a - b = 0 := by
        
        cases h₃ with
        | inl h₃ =>
          
          have h₅ : a = b := h₃
          have h₆ : a - b = 0 := by
            
            have h₇ : a - b = 0 := by
              
              rw [h₅]
              simp
            exact h₇

        | inr h₃ =>
          
          have h₅ : a = c := h₃
          have h₆ : a - c = 0 := by
            
            have h₇ : a - c = 0 := by
              
              rw [h₅]
              simp
            exact h₇
          exact Or.inr (Or.inl h₆)
      exact h₄
  
  rw [h₁]
  rw [h₂]
  <;> aesop

    · subst h_ac
